statements.status_notes: This CVE is an XSS in the Spark History Server web UI (a separate, standalone server process started via org.apache.spark.deploy.history.HistoryServer's own main class), requiring a user to log into and visit the history web page. This image's entrypoint (image/spark-dependencies/bin/entrypoint.sh) only ever runs `java -jar <job>.jar` against the job's own Main-Class - it never starts the History Server, and the driver's own web UI is separately disabled (spark.ui.enabled=false is hardcoded in the job, see jetty-server.vex.json in this same directory). No Spark web UI of any kind ever starts in this image.

spark-core is bundled via Apache TinkerPop's spark-gremlin 3.7.3, which pins Spark 3.3.x. It provides the optional Spark/Hadoop OLAP backend and is not loaded by the default JanusGraph gremlin-server. Upgrading Spark requires a TinkerPop/Spark 3.5 migration (incompatible transitive baseline, slf4j 2.x); assessment pending.
